bullets.text: Russian DDoS Attacks Intensify - **NCSC** warns critical infrastructure in the UK is under persistent threat from Russian hacktivists.
LilaConnect's Rapid Migration - **LilaConnect** successfully migrated to **gaiia** in just 16 weeks, enhancing its operational efficiency.
New Subsea Cable Announced - **V.tal** plans a 9,700 km subsea cable linking Brazil and the US to boost data capacity.
Telecom Retail Experience Reimagined - **iQmetrix** aims to transform telecom retail experiences at the upcoming **MWC Barcelona**.
Liberty Global Eyes Acquisition - **Liberty Global** is in talks to acquire **Three Ireland**, potentially worth €1.5 billion.
Private 5G Security Gaps - Bridging security gaps in **Private 5G** networks is crucial for protecting enterprise operations.
AI's Role in Telecoms - **Verizon** integrates AI into network operations to enhance efficiency and support enterprise demands.
Spectrum Access Changes Ahead - European telecom operators may gain longer access to radio spectrum, easing planning challenges.
Starlink Service Surges in Ukraine - **Starlink's** Direct-to-Cell service reaches over 3 million users in Ukraine, enhancing connectivity.
